content:
We are pushing into the final week of Black Friday 2026 and the deals just went wild – Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 are down again to an insane $149 today (that’s $100 off!), the latest Apple Watch Series 12 as dropped again to all-time lows at $100 off, and M5 MacBook Air has dropped to its lowest price in nearly 6 months at up $310 off starting from $989 shipped. As if that wasn’t already enough, the iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) has fallen to its best price of the year at $49 and the brand new OLED iPad mini has now hit a new all-time low at $100 off. But there’s a whole ton more than that waiting below.

Update:

  • Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 just hit the lowest price ever at $18 via Amazon.
  • MacBook Neo 256GB has now dropped in price again to $599 (Reg. $700)

Whoa! Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 just hit a wild $149 all-time low for Black Friday (100 off!)

Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 have just dropped to the lowest price ever at Amazon – they are now down to just $149 shipped! This is a straight up $100 discount and very best deal we have ever tracked at Amazon.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – Now even lower

This deal lands on the heels of Apple Watch Series 12 dropping even lower to $100 off with models starting from $299 (this is a new Amazon all-time low and the best price ever), and some very impressive $300+ price drops on M5 MacBook Air – the 13-inch is now at $989 and the 15-inch at $1,197.

Just after dropping AirPods Pro 3 down $179, and then again to $169, Amazon has dropped the price again to astonishing $149 shipped for this year’s massive Black Friday sale.

Regularly $249, this is $100 off and the very best deal we have tracked at Amazon.

As part of its official Amazon Black Friday sale and just after dropping AirPods Pro 3 again to an incredible $149 shipped ($100 off!), Amazon has now dropped the price on Apple Watch Series 12 again as well – you’ll now find the best prices ever across just about every model in the lineup at $100 off.

Much like we saw with AirPods Pro 3, Amazon delivered particularly notable all-time lows across the Series 12 lineup for the launch of this year’s Black Friday sale event at $70 off, but it has now dropped the price again across the entire lineup to deliver the very best deals we have tracked to date.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 $299 (Reg. $399) – All-time low

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 Cell $399 (Reg. $499) – All-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 Cell $449 (Reg. $549) – All-time low

M5 MacBook Air Black Friday deals drop even lower, now up to $310 off with models from $989

Okay here we go folks, Amazon just dropped the most affordable M5 MacBook Air models again to some seriously impressive prices with the 13-inch now at $989 and the 15-inch to $1,197. That’s over $300 off, the best deals of the season, and arguably the best Black Friday MacBook deals we have tracked overall.

These amazing MacBook Air deals land on the heels of a wild $100 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, the best deals ever on the Apple Watch Series 12 lineup at $100 off, a new all-time low on the new OLED iPad mini at $100 off, and the best deal of the year on Apple’s iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) at just $49.

The same applies to the entry 15-inch variant with 16GB of RAM and 512GB storage that is now starting down at $1,196.10 shipped. This one carries a $1,499 list price and is now $303 off the list for the very best deal of the season.

iVANKY 26-in-1 Thunderbolt 5 FusionDock Ultra now $150 off for Black Friday

iVANKY’s Thunderbolt 5 FusionDock Ultra has dropped to its very best price of the year at $599.99 exclusively via the brand’s official site and over on Amazon using code 9TO5MAC for Black Friday 2026 (also available on Amazon UK at £599.99 with no coded needed). That’s $150 off and $50 under the next best price of 2026. If you’re looking to setup a powerful workstation or upgrade your existing rig, the 26-port FusionDock Ultra is specifically designed to elevate demanding Apple Silicon Mac workstations with support for up to four native 6K displays, 140W charging, 10Gb Ethernet, and a combination of dual-chip architecture and active cooling for stable, dependable performance – scope out our hands-on review for a closer look. If the FusionDock Ultra is a bit overkill for you, the FusionDock Max 2 is a more affordable alternative that still delivers the Thunderbolt 5 and multi-display connectivity you need for a capable Mac workstation – it’s now down at $359.99 from the regular $449.99 for Black Friday.

  • iVANKY FusionDock Ultra $600 ($150 off)
